arithmetic: Exact rational evaluation of saved floating-point weights and verified certificates

protocol.experiment: 32 matched decoder restarts on each of 13 historical XOR circuits
protocol.schedule: Initial learning rates for first 75% of steps; one tenth thereafter
protocol.positive_weight_objective: mean XOR BCE + lambda * mean four-bit reconstruction BCE
protocol.zero_weight_control: Circuit frozen; decoder fits the original fixed final codes using reconstruction BCE
protocol.decoder_standardization: Fixed means and standard deviations of each original circuit final code, shared across arms and folded into exported decoder
protocol.checkpoint_selection: Frozen control: maximize reconstructed patterns, then minimize reconstruction loss. Joint: maximize patterns with all six outputs correct, then total correct task-patterns, then minimize joint loss. Every 250 steps including endpoints; no readability term.
protocol.paired_arms: Identical initial circuit, decoder, learning-rate assignment and decoder normalization

example_selection_rule: Prefer lambda=1; among eligible runs choose smallest joint selection loss, then id
